name: GitHub Auth
description: Sign in to a shared workspace with GitHub and inherit your role from the linked repository's collaborator permissions — admin → admin, push/maintain → member, pull/triage → guest. Zero-admin onboarding: everyone with repo access can join. Ships as an auth-provider plugin with zero core edits.

provider.name: GitHub
provider.description: Repo-collaborator-derived identity + roles via GitHub App (or PAT fallback).

auth_mode.description: How the provider authenticates to the GitHub API for permission checks. 'app' = GitHub App installation token (preferred — installation-scoped, org-approvable). 'pat' = a personal access token fallback.

client_id.description: GitHub App / OAuth App client id. Required for device flow (host sign-in) and web flow (guest sign-in).

client_secret.description: OAuth client secret. Required only for the web (authorization-code) flow used by invited guests via the worker trampoline.

app_id.description: GitHub App id (auth_mode = app). Used to mint installation access tokens for permission checks.

installation_id.description: GitHub App installation id on the org/repo (auth_mode = app).

private_key.description: GitHub App private key (PEM, RS256). Used to sign the App JWT (auth_mode = app).

api_token.description: Personal access token used for collaborator/permission reads (auth_mode = pat). Needs repo read + org member read.

repo.description: Default linked repository as 'owner/name'. The workspace auth-link overrides this.

role_map.description: Optional override of the GitHub-permission → workspace-role map. Keys: admin, maintain, write/push, triage, read/pull. Values: owner|admin|member|guest|deny.

sync_interval_minutes.description: How often to re-pull the collaborator directory and re-verify members. Default 30.
